observed_structure: Each SIMDgroup owns one logical Q, gate, K, or V projection row, with eight row owners sharing a threadgroup.
SIMDgroup lanes walk packed char4 columns with a literal stride of 32.
A layer-slot-adjusted global row selects the packed weight row and its FP32 group-scale row.
Each lane converts one char4 weight vector to FP32, takes its dot product with the corresponding normalized float4 input, and applies the row-local group scale.
An FP32 register accumulates the scaled vector dot products before simd_sum reduces them across the SIMDgroup.
Lane zero publishes the reduced row value directly into the device Q/Gate/K/V projection buffer.
variant_notes: The cited kernel uses fixed model dimensions and the file-level packed group constant, while layer_slot selects the resident layer's weight and scale rows.
An out-of-range Q/Gate/K/V row returns the entire SIMDgroup before the lane-strided dot product.
The cited kernel reads float4 values from its normalized input buffer and writes concatenated Q, gate, K, and V projection rows.
